label: Twilio
description: Arcade.dev LLM tools for sending and reading SMS through Twilio

tools.name: ListConversationMessages
tools.description:
List SMS messages exchanged with one contact, newest first.

Includes messages that contact sent to the Twilio number and messages sent to that contact
from the Twilio number. Pass the returned cursor to read older messages. A cursor only
continues the same numbers and page size.

parameters.name: contact_number
parameters.description: Only include SMS messages exchanged with this phone number, in E.164 format.

parameters.name: on_number
parameters.description: Read the conversation on this Twilio phone number, in E.164 format. Defaults to the account's only SMS-capable number.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum results to return (1-50). Defaults to 20.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Continue an earlier page of this same conversation. Defaults to the first page.

tools.name: ListPhoneNumbers
tools.description:
List SMS-capable phone numbers on the Twilio account, in ascending order by phone number.

A page can be shorter than the limit when numbers on it cannot send SMS. Pass the returned
cursor to read the next page.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum results to return (1-50). Defaults to 20.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Continue an earlier page of SMS-capable numbers. Defaults to the first page.

tools.name: ListReceivedMessages
tools.description:
List SMS messages received on a Twilio number, newest first.

Pass the returned cursor to read the next, older page. A page cursor only continues the
same number and page size.

parameters.name: on_number
parameters.description: Only include SMS messages received by this Twilio phone number, in E.164 format. Defaults to the account's only SMS-capable number.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum results to return (1-50). Defaults to 20.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Continue an earlier page of messages received by the same number. Defaults to the first page.

tools.name: SendSms
tools.description:
Send an SMS from a Twilio phone number on this account.

Returns the new message SID and Twilio's status for it. A trial account can text only
verified destination numbers. If Twilio does not confirm the send, the message may already
exist.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Send the SMS to this phone number, in E.164 format.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: The text of the SMS. At most 1600 characters.

parameters.name: from_number
parameters.description: Send the SMS from this Twilio phone number, in E.164 format. Defaults to the account's only SMS-capable number.

body.value: Hello! Your appointment is confirmed for tomorrow at 10:00 AM. Reply STOP to unsubscribe.

summary:
## Twilio Toolkit

The Twilio toolkit lets agents send and read SMS messages through Twilio's API using your account's phone numbers. It provides programmatic access to conversations, inboxes, and outbound messaging without requiring OAuth.

## Capabilities

- **Outbound messaging:** Send SMS from any SMS-capable Twilio number on the account; returns message SID and delivery status. Trial accounts are limited to verified destination numbers.
- **Conversation threading:** Retrieve the full two-way message history with a specific contact (both inbound and outbound), paginated newest-first via cursor.
- **Inbox reading:** List inbound SMS received on a Twilio number, paginated newest-first; cursor is scoped to the same number and page size.
- **Phone number discovery:** Enumerate SMS-capable numbers on the account in ascending order; pages may be shorter than the requested limit when numbers lack SMS capability.

## Secrets

All three secrets are required. Twilio uses an Account SID plus an API Key SID/Secret pair (not the primary auth token) for scoped, revocable access.

- **`TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID`** — The unique identifier for your Twilio account, always beginning with `AC`. Found in the [Twilio Console dashboard](https://console.twilio.com/) under **Account Info**. This is not a secret in isolation but is required alongside the API key pair to authenticate requests.

- **`TWILIO_API_KEY_SID`** — The SID of a Twilio API Key, beginning with `SK`. Create API Keys in the Twilio Console under **Account → API Keys & Tokens** ([docs](https://www.twilio.com/docs/iam/api-keys)). Choose **Standard** key type unless your use case requires **Main**. Copy the SID immediately after creation.

- **`TWILIO_API_KEY_SECRET`** — The secret associated with the API Key above. It is displayed **only once** at creation time in the Twilio Console; if lost, the key must be revoked and a new one created. Store it securely before closing the creation dialog.

For general guidance on storing secrets in Arcade, see the [Arcade secrets docs](https://docs.arcade.dev/en/guides/create-tools/tool-basics/create-tool-secrets). You can manage stored secrets at [https://api.arcade.dev/dashboard/auth/secrets](https://api.arcade.dev/dashboard/auth/secrets).
